node_mgmt_desc: This is the master command center for all active tenant nodes on the HIVE.OS network.
provision_desc: Click here to allocate new infrastructure. You will define the organization name, capacity plan, and establish super admin credentials.
matrix_search_desc: Filter the active node list instantly by ID or Organization Name.
copy_desc: Quickly copy the current view to your clipboard for sharing.
export_desc: Download the complete dataset in your preferred format (CSV, Excel).
print_desc: Send the current configuration list to your PDF/Print processor.
refresh_desc: Manually refresh the datatable to pull the latest telemetry from the network.
inspect_desc: View deep metrics, routing domains, and active capacity plans for this specific node.
power_desc: Instantly suspend or restore network access for this tenant database.
clearance_desc: Enable or disable Super Admin login capabilities.
reconfig_desc: Update the organization name, adjust the capacity plan, or modify routing rules.
purge_desc: Permanently delete this node and destroy all associated telemetry data. Use with extreme caution.
audit_desc: This immutable ledger cryptographically records every action taken across the network.
ledger_desc: Switch between the fast-access Active Live Logs and the deep Cold Storage Vault.
scope_desc: Filter telemetry strictly from Central Command or specific Tenant Nodes.
time_desc: Quickly jump to specific timeframes or set custom date boundaries to hunt for events.
vault_desc: Configure automated retention policies or manually trigger a cold storage sweep.
deep_search_desc: Search the ledger instantly by operator name, description, or module.
forensic_desc: Inspect the raw JSON payload and exact metadata footprint of a specific event.
